title: Compresso
description: Compress your screenshots into smaller PNG, WebP, JPEG & AVIF files
body:
Compresso adds a configurable optimization step to Minecraft's screenshot saving. Every screenshot you take is encoded into a smaller file in the format that you choose, with control over quality, compression effort, and resolution.

![Configuration screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b6313cfc82bb73985d2ebb2556b44abb1a6714c.png)

## Supported formats
* PNG: lossless
* JPEG: lossy
* WebP: lossless/lossy
* AVIF: lossless/lossy


For users who want maximum compression or to use the AVIF format, this mod can call command-line encoders if it detects that you have them installed on your system. This includes `avifenc`, `cwebp`, `oxipng`, and `cjpeg`.
